question: Can the AIOps2025 Type Accuracy fallback -- 'embedding-similarity for unhit cases' -- be honoured by a model this repository is allowed to ship?
clause: Type Accuracy (TA) is calculated via two-step matching: keyword detection against the ground-truth fault descriptions, with embedding-similarity fallback for unhit cases.
permitted: A model this repository may ship is offline, deterministic, carries no vendored weights (check-no-vendored-data.mjs refuses anything over 1 MiB of data) and needs no secret. A hosted embedding API fails the first and the third; a neural embedding fails the second. What survives is a surface model.
decisionRule: A model ships only if one threshold both admits every paraphrase (a reason naming the same fault without a single content word of its description) and refuses every distractor (a reason naming a different fault from this table), with a margin of at least 0.05; the threshold would then be the midpoint of that margin, the only value that encodes no preference between a false credit and a false refusal.
marginWhy: At three decimal places a cosine whose classes sit 0.05 apart is separated by tokeniser noise -- a stop word, a plural, a hyphen -- rather than by meaning.
distractorMethod: The positives are written by hand, because a paraphrase is the thing under test. The negatives are the cross product: for each pair, every other pair's paraphrase against this pair's description, so ten pairs give ninety measurements and none of them was chosen. A reason that describes fault A must not be credited to fault B, which is the rule the fallback would have to honour.

pairs.description: CPU saturation on the order service
pairs.paraphrase: the processor was pinned at its ceiling on the tier that takes purchases

pairs.description: memory leak in the payment gateway
pairs.paraphrase: the charge tier kept holding heap until the kernel killed it

pairs.description: network packet loss between checkout and currency
pairs.paraphrase: frames were dropped on the link joining the basket and pricing tiers

pairs.description: disk io latency on the cart database
pairs.paraphrase: the storage volume behind the basket store answered slowly
the standby copy ran out of workers while replaying writes

pairs.description: thread pool exhaustion in the search service
pairs.paraphrase: the query tier ran out of workers to hand requests to

pairs.description: dns resolution failure for the currency service
pairs.paraphrase: name lookups for the pricing tier stopped answering

pairs.description: connection pool exhaustion on the inventory service
pairs.paraphrase: the stock tier had no free sockets left

pairs.description: gc pause storm in the recommendation service
pairs.paraphrase: the suggestion tier stalled in repeated collection cycles

pairs.description: clock skew on the shipping service
pairs.paraphrase: the delivery tier reported timestamps that drifted apart

guard.note: The string the scorer's own mutation grid substitutes for a reason. It must stay below any threshold this table would ever justify, or the fallback would make Type Accuracy unfailable and `runOfficialRegression` would report the target as unmutatable.

verdict.reason: no surface model separates the classes: the highest-scoring distractor for char-5gram-cosine scores 0.148, above the lowest-scoring paraphrase at 0.021, so every threshold either refuses a paraphrase or credits a description of a different fault
